name: Acadia National Park
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) is warmest for the coast, fall foliage in Oct is spectacular, and Park Loop Road largely closes to cars Dec–Apr.
overview: Rocky Maine coastline, with the Park Loop Road past pink-granite shoreline, lobster harbors, and Cadillac Mountain sunrises.
costOverview: Bar Harbor's lobster-shack economy pushes Acadia pricier than the average national park, even for a casual lobster roll.

specialSeasons.text: Cadillac Mountain is the first place in the continental US to see sunrise during this stretch of the year — a real, if niche, reason to be up early.
Park Loop Road is largely closed to vehicles through this window; the carriage roads stay open for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing instead.
